name: 融合检索
description: Boolean patent search, semantic result pages, and semantic baseline tools for the remote Fusion Search service, with built-in token acquisition and refresh.

agentTools.name: fusion_semantic_baseline
agentTools.description: Goal: produce a semantic baseline for one explicitly specified patent claim, not the application as a whole. A case-number source can yield broader terms, so compare the returned terms and weights with the target claim. Prefer an application or publication number: call prepare with the matching reference_kind; if appropriate, keep it, otherwise first refine terms/weights with update_terms. If it remains unsuitable, call prepare with reference_kind=text and reference containing your own concise paraphrase of the technical solution in that one claim. Base it on your understanding; do not copy the claim verbatim or use the full application, then refine the returned terms and weights. Case-number input accepts only application numbers or publication numbers. prepare immediately returns the element_id and active Chinese and English terms with weights; update_terms saves complete replacement lists for the same claim. Authentication is automatic; credentials are configured in the plugin data directory, never in tool arguments.

action.description: prepare=create a baseline from the selected source and immediately return its terms and weights; update_terms=refine and save complete lists for that same target claim. Both actions mutate remote state.

reference.description: Input to prepare: an application/publication number, or your concise paraphrase of the technical solution in the one target claim. Write it from your understanding; do not copy the claim verbatim or use the full application text.

reference_kind.description: For prepare, use application_number or publication_number for case-number input, or text for your own paraphrase of the target claim's technical solution. Do not copy the claim verbatim. No other case-number type is accepted.

element_id.description: The element_id returned by prepare, required by update_terms.

chinese.description: The complete desired Chinese term list for the same target claim. Omit to preserve the current Chinese list.

english.description: The complete desired English term list for the same target claim. Omit to preserve the current English list.

verify.description: Read the saved terms again after update_terms. Defaults to true; the verified terms and weights are returned.

agentTools.name: fusion_boolean_search
agentTools.description: Execute one Boolean patent search against a single database using the active semantic baseline. Inputs are the displayed database code and Boolean query; the service catalog resolves the provider's internal database ID and the current semantic element is resolved from a prepared baseline or the account's selected baseline. Returns only total_hits and the opaque semantically sorted session_id needed to retrieve result pages. Keeps up to 400 candidates. Searching creates remote search history and is never automatically replayed after an uncertain outcome. Uses the same private token settings and automatic refresh as fusion_semantic_baseline.

database.description: Displayed Fusion Search database code. CTTXT is accepted as an alias for the provider's canonical code CNTXT; internal dbId values are resolved automatically from the live catalog.

query.description: Boolean query expression for the selected database.

agentTools.name: fusion_semantic_result_page
agentTools.description: Read one page from an existing Fusion Search session using the opaque session_id. The page size is fixed at 20, abstracts are requested, and start is calculated from page. Returns only results carrying simVal and semanticSort in semantic-rank order. Abstract and main-claim fields are plain text with HTML/XML markup and provider labels removed. Sessions without semantic-sort metadata are rejected rather than presented as ranked. Does not rerun or modify the search.

session_id.description: Opaque session_id returned by fusion_boolean_search or another semantically sorted Fusion Search session.

page.description: One-based page number. The page size is fixed internally at 20.
